summary: No concrete mismatch for the advertised counter DOM subset. Scope note: React innerHTML may include comment separators around adjacent text; compare structured DOM/text or normalize comments.
review_report: W5 review: interaction/dom.mjs/demo accepted for the advertised counter DOM subset; I found no concrete mismatch. Evidence in dom.mjs: child-index path resolution, validates effects unsupported, dispatches only current declared handler, suppresses disabled button via native button behavior, ignores stale detached handlers (pathElements identity), synchronously redraws from returned snapshot, exposes separate runtime and DOM snapshots, and unmount clears children/state. demo.html points at ./build/wasm_exec.js + ./build/counter.wasm and ./dom.mjs, waits for Go init, displays runtime/DOM and errors. Scope note only: React innerHTML may contain comment separators around adjacent text; structured DOM/text should be compared or comments normalized. This is an expected framework serialization difference, not an observed semantic mismatch.
